goal: Allow REST clients to fetch headers for stale blocks not on the active chain
Enables tools like fork-observer to inspect non-active blocks during or after re-orgs
agreement: Tested and prefers query parameter approach over a new endpoint (jeanpablojp)
Supports use case but asks if a dedicated endpoint would be cleaner (0xB10C)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it provides clear value for external REST consumers following re-orgs
Valuable for fork monitoring tools but deferrable without system-wide urgency
